decision_question: Where should we invest in AI healthcare solutions to achieve the highest ROI by 2026?

hypotheses.hypothesis: By 2026, AI-powered diagnostic imaging will be the largest segment by revenue, driven by FDA clearances and reimbursement expansion.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Determines where to allocate R&D and sales resources.
needed_evidence: Revenue growth rates of top AI imaging companies, number of FDA clearances per year, reimbursement codes added.

hypotheses.hypothesis: AI-driven drug discovery will reduce average development time by 30% by 2026, but will not yet significantly impact blockbuster drug revenues.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Informs investment in drug discovery AI vs. clinical-stage AI.
needed_evidence: Time savings reported by pharma companies using AI, number of AI-discovered drugs in Phase III, revenue from AI-discovered drugs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Virtual nursing assistants and AI triage will reduce hospital readmission rates by 15% by 2026, but adoption will be limited to large hospital systems.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Target market for patient engagement AI solutions.
needed_evidence: Readmission rate reductions from pilot studies, adoption rates by hospital size, cost savings per bed.
search_queries: AI virtual nursing assistant readmission reduction

hypotheses.hypothesis: By 2026, over 50% of US hospitals will have deployed at least one AI-powered clinical decision support system, but physician burnout will remain a barrier.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Indicates market saturation and need for workflow integration.
needed_evidence: Survey data on CDS adoption, physician satisfaction scores, EHR integration rates.
search_queries: AI clinical decision support adoption hospitals 2025

hypotheses.hypothesis: China will surpass the US in AI healthcare patent filings by 2026, but US will lead in clinical validation and commercial revenue.
needed_evidence: Patent filing counts by country, clinical trial registrations, revenue by region.
search_queries: AI healthcare clinical trials US China 2025

hypotheses.hypothesis: AI-powered remote patient monitoring will reduce chronic disease management costs by 20% by 2026, driven by value-based care models.
needed_evidence: Cost reduction studies, RPM adoption rates, value-based care contract growth.
search_queries: AI remote patient monitoring cost savings 2025

hypotheses.hypothesis: By 2026, the AI healthcare market will consolidate around 3-5 major platform players, with startups focusing on niche applications.
needed_evidence: Market share data, funding rounds, acquisition announcements.

market_sizing_plan.sizing_question: How large is the credible opportunity for AI in Healthcare 2026 Trends, and which variables still need validation?

methods.formula: Total AI healthcare market = Global healthcare expenditure * AI penetration rate
known_limitations: Penetration rate estimates vary widely; may overstate market if adoption is slower.

methods.formula: Market size = Sum over segments (Number of units * Average price per unit)
search_queries: average AI software spend per hospital 2025
known_limitations: Requires granular data on adoption and pricing; may miss smaller segments.

methods.formula: Market size = Total addressable organizations * Awareness rate * Trial rate * Adoption rate * Average revenue per customer
known_limitations: Funnel rates are often proprietary; assumptions needed.

methods.formula: Market size = Sum of value created (cost savings + revenue uplift) * capture rate
variables: Cost savings per use case (e.g., readmission reduction)
known_limitations: Value creation is difficult to measure; capture rate is speculative.

market_sizing_plan.evidence_rule: Use public source values when available; keep missing variables as validation tasks.

chart_data_needs.title: AI Healthcare Market Size by Segment (2024-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Which segments are growing fastest and where is the largest opportunity?
required_metrics: Segment: Diagnostic Imaging, Drug Discovery, Virtual Nursing, Remote Monitoring, Clinical Decision Support, Others
Market size in USD billions
Source: Grand View Research, Frost & Sullivan, MarketsandMarkets
comparison_set: Segment-level market size for each year
search_queries: AI healthcare market size by segment 2024 2025 2026
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use only published reports; if segment data unavailable, note as estimate and cite CAGR from credible source.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Provide top-down sizing to establish market scale and segment prioritization.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report claims the AI healthcare market will reach $XX billion by 2026. This exhibit quantifies the total and segment breakdown.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Diagnostic imaging and drug discovery are the largest segments; virtual care shows highest growth rate.

chart_data_needs.title: FDA AI Device Approvals by Year and Specialty (2018-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How is regulatory momentum shifting across specialties?
required_metrics: Specialty: Radiology, Cardiology, Neurology, Pathology, Others
Number of FDA 510(k) clearances per year
Source: FDA database, industry analyses
search_queries: FDA AI medical device approvals by year 2018 2024
FDA AI device clearances by specialty 2025
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Require at least 4 annual data points; if 2026 not available, use 2025 as latest and note estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Show regulatory tailwind for AI adoption, especially in imaging.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that FDA clearances are accelerating. This exhibit tracks annual approvals.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Radiology dominates approvals, but cardiology and neurology are growing fast.

chart_data_needs.title: Hospital AI Adoption by Bed Size (2024-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Which hospitals are adopting AI and where are the gaps?
required_metrics: Hospital bed size category: <100, 100-299, 300-499, 500+
Percentage of hospitals that have deployed at least one AI solution
Source: HIMSS, AHA survey, KLAS
comparison_set: Adoption rate by bed size over time
search_queries: hospital AI adoption rate by bed size 2025
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use survey data; if 2026 not available, use 2025 and note as latest.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Demonstrate adoption unevenness to support hypothesis that large hospitals lead.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report claims adoption is real but uneven. This exhibit shows adoption rates by hospital size.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Large hospitals (>500 beds) have >50% adoption; small hospitals (<100 beds) lag below 20%.

chart_data_needs.title: AI Healthcare Funding by Stage and Geography (2020-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Where is venture capital flowing and what does it signal?
required_metrics: Geography: US, China, Europe, Rest of World
Stage: Seed, Series A, Series B, Growth
Total funding amount in USD billions
Number of deals
Source: CB Insights, PitchBook, Rock Health
comparison_set: Bubble size = total funding; x-axis = year; y-axis = stage; color = geography
search_queries: AI healthcare venture capital by geography 2025
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use only published funding data; if 2026 not available, use 2025 as latest.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Show investment trends to validate market growth and geographic hotspots.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report discusses competitive dynamics and funding. This exhibit maps funding by stage and region.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: US leads in total funding, but China's share is growing; early-stage deals dominate.

chart_data_needs.title: Projected Cost Savings from AI in Key Use Cases (2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: What is the ROI of AI adoption for different stakeholders?
required_metrics: Use case: Diagnostic Imaging, Drug Discovery, Virtual Nursing, Remote Monitoring, Clinical Decision Support
Projected annual cost savings in USD billions (2026)
Source: McKinsey, Accenture, academic studies
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use only published estimates; if multiple sources, cite range.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Quantify value pool to support investment thesis.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report claims AI will reduce costs. This exhibit shows projected savings per use case.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Remote monitoring and readmission reduction offer highest savings per patient.

chart_data_needs.title: AI Drug Discovery Time Reduction Milestones (2020-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How is AI reducing drug development timelines?
required_metrics: Metric: Average time (in months) from target identification to preclinical candidate
Source: Pharma company announcements, Nature Reviews Drug Discovery
search_queries: average time AI drug discovery preclinical 2025
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Require at least 4 annual data points; if 2026 not available, use 2025 and note estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Support hypothesis that AI reduces development time by 30% by 2026.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report claims AI will cut drug discovery time. This exhibit tracks reported time savings.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Time from target identification to lead optimization has decreased from 4 years to 2.5 years.

chart_data_needs.title: Key Regulatory Milestones for AI in Healthcare (2018-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: What are the critical regulatory events shaping AI adoption?
required_metrics: Date: Year and month
Event: FDA guidance, EU AI Act passage, CMS reimbursement decision, NMPA approval
Impact: Positive, Negative, Neutral
Source: Regulatory agency announcements
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Include only confirmed dates from official sources; if future event, note as proposed.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Provide chronological context for regulatory tailwinds and headwinds.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report discusses regulatory landscape. This exhibit maps key milestones.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: FDA guidance updates and EU AI Act implementation are pivotal events.
